name: Protection channel asymmetric-delay indication

summary: Identifies a measured or declared difference between the communication path directions.
description: Identifies a measured or declared difference between the communication path directions. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Directional delay information” at the input and “Asymmetry indication” at the output. Compensation depends on the selected protection implementation.
